blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Biomedical research articles are mainly written for experts and often contain terms that are difficult for the general public to understand. Automated lay summarization has become a solution to make biomedical knowledge easier for patients and the public to understand. However, generating lay summaries from full-text articles requires more computing power because the articles are long and costly to process. Fine-tuning large language models for this task also requires substantial resources. This study asks two questions: (1) whether abstracts contain enough information to produce lay summaries as good as those based on full-text articles, and (2) whether few-shot learning performs as well as task-specific fine-tuning. The study used two public biomedical lay summarization datasets and two recent models, evaluated for readability, factual consistency, semantic similarity, and runtime efficiency. Results show that abstract-based summarization performs better overall. Across both datasets and models, abstract fine-tuning is 4.70 times faster, while abstract zero- and few-shot prompting is 5.31 times faster than full-text methods. These results show that abstract-based prompting reduces runtime cost while maintaining lay summary quality.
blocks.zh: 生物医学研究文章主要是为专家撰写的,并经常包含公众难以理解的术语. 自动化的平面归纳已成为使生物医学知识更方便患者和公众理解的一种解决方案. 然而,从全文文章中生成内容提要需要更多的计算能力,因为文章处理时间长而成本高. 精细调整大型语言模式以完成这项任务也需要大量资源。 本研究提出了两个问题:(1) 摘要是否包含足够的资料,以便产生与以全文文章为基础的内容一样好的概要;(2) 少拍学习以及针对具体任务的微调。 这项研究使用了两个公共生物医学分类汇总数据集和两个最近的模型,评价了可读性、事实一致性、语义相似性和运行时间效率。 结果显示,抽象归纳的总体表现更好。 在整个数据集和模型中,抽象的微调速度是4.70倍,而抽象的零发和几发的提示速度是全文方法的5.31倍. 这些结果表明,抽象的催化可以降低运行时间成本,同时保持固定的即时质量。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Biomedical research articles are important means of communicating research findings in the life sciences [ 16 ] . These articles are highly structured and often use dense technical language that can be difficult for non-expert readers to understand [ 45 , 14 ] . Lay summaries have become a useful way to make biomedical research more accessible to these readers [ 36 , 26 ] . Unlike standard summaries, lay summaries prioritise readability and use simpler language, reducing domain-specific terminology and enabling non-expert readers to understand the main findings [ 43 , 52 ] . However, automatically generating lay summaries is often more challenging, as it requires models to improve readability while keeping the summaries relevant and factual [ 1 , 42 ] . For example, Figure 1 illustrates the differences between technical and lay summaries of the same biomedical research article.
blocks.zh: 生物医学研究文章是传播生命科学研究成果的重要手段[16]. 这些文章结构严密,经常使用密集的技术语言,非专家读者可能难以理解[45,14]. 简略摘要已成为使这些读者更容易获得生物医学研究的有益途径[36、26]。 与标准摘要不同的是,摘要确定可读性的优先次序并使用更简单的语言,减少特定领域的术语,使非专家读者能够理解主要结论[43,52]. 然而,自动生成详细摘要往往更具挑战性,因为它要求模型提高可读性,同时保持摘要的相关性和事实性[1、42]。 例如,图1说明了同一生物医学研究文章的技术摘要和摘要之间的差异。

blocks.en: The community-wide BioLaySumm shared task initiative focuses on automatic biomedical lay summarisation and has attracted many researchers since 2023. The BioLaySumm shared task series encourages participants to develop and evaluate their systems within a common framework, and to compare their performance with other approaches [ 17 , 19 , 56 ] . The shared task comprised two subtasks, standard lay summarisation and summarisation with external knowledge, and introduced the PLOS and eLife datasets, which pair biomedical articles with written lay summaries. Although both data sets were curated from full-text journal articles, they differ in authorship and length: PLOS uses short, author-written lay summaries, while eLife is based on longer summaries, approximately twice the length, written by expert editors. [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 社区范围的BioLaySumm共享任务倡议侧重于自动生物医学铺设总结,并自2023年起吸引了许多研究人员. " BioLaySumm " 共享任务系列鼓励参与者在一个共同框架内开发和评价其系统,并将其绩效与其他方法进行比较[17、19、56]。 共同任务包括两个分任务,即标准编目总结和外部知识归纳,并采用了PLOS和eLife数据集,将生物医学文章与书面编目摘要结合起来。 虽然两套数据都来自全文期刊文章,但作者和长度不同: PLOS使用简短的,由作者撰写的编程摘要,而eLife则基于较长的摘要,长度约为专家编辑的两倍. [20].

blocks.en: The length of the text increases the computational cost of training and inference, as longer articles require more tokens to be processed [ 22 , 48 ] . In automatic lay summarisation, this aspect can become more critical, depending on the content provided as input to the model. For instance, an eLife abstract requires an average of 217 tokens, whereas the corresponding full-text article requires an average of 14,046 tokens, as shown in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 文本的长度增加了培训和推论的计算成本,因为较长的条款需要处理更多的符号[22,48]. 在自动的平面归纳中,这一方面可能变得更加关键,这取决于作为模型投入的内容。 例如,eLife抽象需要平均217个令牌,而相应的全文文章则需要平均14,046个令牌,如表2所示。

blocks.en: The existing literature demonstrates considerable variation in how much source information is provided to biomedical lay summarization models. Some systems rely exclusively on abstracts [ 51 , 24 , 18 , 32 ] , whereas others use abstracts supplemented with retrieved full-text passages [ 30 ] , abstracts combined with conclusions [ 5 ] , selected sections [ 54 ] , salient sentences [ 15 , 44 ] , or the complete article [ 31 , 12 ] . In addition, studies differ in their model architectures, prompting strategies, fine-tuning procedures, preprocessing methods, and evaluation settings. Consequently, direct conclusions about the effect of input scope remain difficult to draw.
blocks.zh: 现有文献表明,在向生物医学概括模型提供多少来源信息方面,存在着相当大的差异。 有些系统完全依赖摘要[51、24、18、32],而另一些系统则使用以检索全文段落为补充的摘要[30]、与结论[5]合并的摘要、选定的第[54]节、突出句[15、44]或完整的第[31、12]条]。 此外,研究在模型架构,促动策略,微调程序,预处理方法,评价设置方面也有不同. 因此,仍然难以就投入范围的影响得出直接结论。

blocks.en: Although several studies have compared or combined different input configurations, these comparisons are often embedded within different modeling frameworks or evaluated under different experimental conditions. For example, abstract-based methods may employ few-shot prompting [ 51 , 24 , 18 , 32 ] , whereas full-text approaches may rely on fine-tuning or long-document architectures [ 31 , 12 ] . Similarly, content-selection systems [ 54 , 15 ] introduce additional variables, which are the qualities of the selected sentences and the dependents of the extraction method. These differences make it difficult to determine whether improvements arise from the additional source information itself or from the particular model or pre-processing strategy used to exploit it.
blocks.zh: 虽然有多项研究比较或合并了不同的输入配置,但这些比较往往嵌入不同的建模框架或在不同的实验条件下进行评估. 例如,抽象方法可能采用几发提示[51、24、18、32],而全文方法可能依赖于微调或长文件结构[31、12]。 同样,内容选择系统[54,15]引入了额外的变量,即所选句子的品质和提取方法的依附. 由于这些差异,很难确定改进是来自额外来源信息本身,还是来自用于利用这些信息的特定模型或预处理策略。

blocks.en: A particularly relevant question is therefore how much of a biomedical article is actually necessary for high-quality lay summarization. An abstract provides a concise representation of the article while it may omit methodological details, findings, or contextual information that could improve factuality and informativeness. Conversely, full-text input provides substantially more information, on the other hand it increases sequence length, computational cost, and the amount of potentially irrelevant content that the model must process. Although selected-content approaches attempt to address this trade-off, they introduce an additional content-selection component.
blocks.zh: 因此,一个特别相关的问题是,生物医学文章究竟需要多少,才能进行高质量的概括。 一份摘要对该条作了简要的表述,但可能省略了方法细节、结论或背景信息,从而可以提高事实性和信息性。 反之,全文输入提供了大量的信息,另一方面它增加了序列长度,计算成本,以及模型必须处理的潜在无关内容的数量. 虽然有选择的内容方法试图解决这种取舍,但它们引入了一个额外的内容选择部分。

blocks.en: The present work investigates the input-scope question explained above by systematically examining different amounts of source information under controlled experimental conditions. Rather than treating abstract-based and full-text summarization as fundamentally different tasks, we investigate them as alternative input configurations for the same general summarization objective. This enables a more direct analysis of the extent to which additional article-level information contributes to the quality of biomedical lay summarization, while also considering the associated information. In this study, we reported the experimental results on two different datasets with two different models and tested the statistical significance of the experimental results. Interestingly, our results show the opposite trend, with abstract-based approaches performing better than full-text approaches.
blocks.zh: 本工作通过在受控制的实验条件下系统审查不同数量的来源信息来调查上述输入镜问题. 我们不是将抽象的和全文的总结作为根本不同的任务来对待,而是将其作为同一总的总结目标的替代输入配置来调查. 这使得能够更直接地分析额外条款一级的信息在多大程度上有助于提高生物医学概括的质量,同时也考虑相关信息。 在这项研究中,我们用两个不同的模型报告了两个不同数据集的实验结果,并测试了实验结果的统计意义. 有趣的是,我们的结果显示了相反的趋势,抽象的方法比全文方法做得更好。

blocks.en: Based on these issues, this study addresses two research questions: • RQ1: Is an abstract alone sufficient to generate lay summaries that are comparable to those generated from the full article in terms of relevance, readability, and factual consistency? • RQ2: Can few-shot prompting achieve performance comparable to task-specific LoRA fine-tuning while requiring less computational time?

blocks.en: The main contribution of this study is a systematic, controlled evaluation of the sufficiency of abstracts for biomedical lay summarization, examining the trade-off between summary quality and computational efficiency. The results demonstrate that abstract-based LoRA fine-tuning achieves superior overall performance, as measured by a composite score integrating readability, relevance, and factual consistency, while reducing fine-tuning runtime by a factor of 4.70 compared with full-text LoRA fine-tuning. These findings challenge the assumption that access to full-text articles is necessary to produce high-quality biomedical lay summaries and suggest that abstracts may provide a more computationally efficient alternative without compromising, and potentially improving, overall summary quality.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的主要贡献是对生物医学概括摘要的充分性进行系统、有控制的评价,审查摘要质量与计算效率之间的权衡。 结果显示,抽象的LORA微调能实现优异的整体性能,以综合分数综合可读性,相关性和事实一致性来衡量,同时将微调运行时间比全文LORA微调减少4.70倍. 这些结论对以下假设提出质疑,即获取全文文章是制作高质量生物医学概要的必要条件,并表明摘要可能在不损害和可能改进总体概要质量的情况下提供更具有计算效率的替代办法。

blocks.en: Beyond fine-tuning, this study systematically investigates few-shot prompting with abstracts, broadening the comparison to include a parameter-efficient training approach and a training-free alternative. Furthermore, it expands the evaluation framework used in previous BioLaySumm studies by incorporating FENICE [ 60 ] and LongDocFACTScore [ 35 ] alongside established evaluation metrics. This multidimensional assessment provides a more comprehensive basis for comparing summarization strategies in terms of linguistic quality, relevance, factual consistency, and computational cost.
blocks.zh: 除了微调外,本研究报告还系统地调查了几发摘要,扩大了比较范围,以包括参数效率高的培训办法和无培训的替代办法。 此外,它扩大了以往的BioLay概要研究中使用的评价框架,将FENICE [60] 和LongDocFACTScore [35] 与既定的评价衡量标准并列。 这一多层面评估为在语言质量、相关性、事实一致性和计算成本方面比较归纳战略提供了一个更全面的基础。

blocks.en: Related work
blocks.zh: 相关工作

blocks.en: Automatic summarization has been extensively studied across news, scientific, and biomedical domains. Scientific summarization presents particular challenges due to the length of research articles, the complexity of their content, and the need to preserve essential information [ 11 ] . To address the computational demands of long-document processing, models such as Longformer and Longformer Encoder-Decoder (LED) were developed to handle longer input sequences [ 6 ] , while PEGASUS was designed specifically for abstractive summarization [ 58 ] . Biomedical lay summarization introduces an additional challenge: generated summaries must convey scientifically accurate information in language accessible to non-expert readers. An important methodological consideration is therefore how much of the source article is needed to generate summaries that balance relevance, readability, and factual consistency. Accordingly, this section reviews previous work from three perspectives based on input strategy: abstract-based methods, content-selection methods, and full-text methods.
blocks.zh: 在新闻、科学和生物医学领域,对自动归纳进行了广泛的研究。 科学总结由于研究文章的篇幅,内容的复杂性,以及保存基本信息的必要性,提出了特殊的挑战[11]. 为满足长文件处理的计算需求,开发了Longformer和Longformer Encoder-Decoder(LED)等模型来处理较长的输入序列[6],而PEGASUS则专门用于抽象的概括[58]. 生物医学编外总结带来了另一个挑战:生成的总结必须用非专家读者可以利用的语言,科学地传递准确的信息。 因此,一个重要的方法考虑因素是,需要多少来源文章来编写摘要,以平衡相关性、可读性和事实一致性。 因此,本节根据投入战略从三个角度审查以前的工作:抽象方法、内容选择方法和全文方法。

blocks.en: Abstract-based strategies
blocks.zh: 基于摘要的战略

blocks.en: Several studies have compared abstract input with longer article input for biomedical lay summarization. Basu et al. compared abstract-only and full-text fine-tuning on the eLife validation set and found trade-offs between relevance, readability, factuality, and inference time [ 4 ] . However, the comparison was limited to a single eLife split, so it remains unclear whether the same pattern holds on PLOS. Goldsack et al. reported a similar comparison for zero-shot prompting, again on eLife [ 18 ] . Together, these studies suggest that abstracts can be competitive with full text, but the evidence remains limited across datasets and adaptation methods.
blocks.zh: 一些研究将抽象投入与较长的生物医学概括性文章投入作了比较。 巴苏等. 比较关于eLife验证集的仅抽象和全文的微调,并在相关性、可读性、事实性和推断时间之间找到权衡。 然而,比较仅限于一次eLife拆分,所以PLOS是否维持同样的模式仍然不清楚. Goldsack等 (英语). 在eLife[18]上, 这些研究加在一起表明,摘要可以对全文具有竞争力,但各种数据集和调整方法的证据仍然有限。

blocks.en: Other studies extended abstract-based prompting to both PLOS and eLife. LaySummX compared abstract-only and full-text zero-shot prompting and found that abstract input gave better factuality scores on both datasets, while relevance and readability varied between them [ 30 ] . The 5cNLP team also tested zero- and few-shot prompting with abstracts and different article sections [ 32 ] . These studies covered a wider range of prompting settings, but did not compare the same abstract and full-text conditions across both prompting and fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 其他研究将抽象的提示推广到PLOS和eLife。 内容摘要 X比较了抽象的和全文的零镜头提示,发现抽象输入在两个数据集上都给出了更好的事实分数,而相关性和可读性则在它们之间有所不同[30]. 5cNLP团队还用摘要和不同文章部分[32]进行了零射和数射的测试. 这些研究涵盖更广泛的提示设置,但没有在提示和微调两方面对相同的抽象和全文条件进行比较。

blocks.en: Several studies have combined abstract-based fine-tuning with prompting. Saama Technologies used LoRA fine-tuning on abstracts together with zero- and six-shot generation [ 24 ] , while SINAI compared two-shot prompting with abstract-based fine-tuning [ 9 ] . DeakinNLP also compared fine-tuning with zero- and few-shot prompting, although its fine-tuning input included both abstracts and conclusions [ 50 ] . Earlier work by MDC similarly compared abstract-based fine-tuning with three-shot prompting [ 51 ] . These studies compared several adaptation methods, but did not apply the same methods to both abstract and full-text input.
blocks.zh: 若干研究将抽象的微调与催化结合起来。 萨玛 技术在摘要上使用了LORA微调,加上零和六发的生成[24],而SINAI则比较了二发提示与抽象的微调[. 9] (中文(简体) ). DeakinNLP还将微调与零镜头和几镜头的提示进行对比,尽管其微调输入同时包括摘要和结论[50]. MDC的早期工作同样将抽象的微调与三发提示对比[51]. 这些研究比较了几种适应方法,但对抽象输入和全文输入没有采用同样的方法。

blocks.en: Other work reduced the amount of article text used during fine-tuning. TLPIQ trained on the abstract and conclusion sections of PLOS and eLife [ 5 ] , while MetninOzU limited each article to its first ten sentences [ 15 ] . Both approaches showed that shorter inputs can support competitive lay summarization, but neither directly compared abstract-only and full-text fine-tuning under the same conditions.
blocks.zh: 其他工作减少了微调时使用的文章文本数量。 TLPIQ就PLOS和eLife的抽象和结论部分进行了培训[5],而MetninOzU则将每篇文章限制在前十句[15]. 这两种方法都表明,较短的投入可以支持竞争性的概括,但不能在同样条件下直接比较抽象和全文的微调。

blocks.en: Content selection strategies
blocks.zh: 内容选择战略

blocks.en: Several studies have explored strategies for reducing the amount of source text processed during lay summary generation. RainCityNLP employed TF–IDF to select a subset of sentences from full-text articles prior to training summarization models [ 46 , 54 ] . Similarly, MIRAGES adopted an extract-then-summarize approach, selecting salient sentences from full-text articles and fine-tuning Llama-3-8B-Instruct using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) [ 39 ] . These approaches aim to reduce the volume of input text processed by the summarization model while retaining relevant information from the full article.
blocks.zh: 一些研究探讨了减少在编程摘要生成过程中处理的源文本数量的战略。 RainCityNLP使用TF-IDF在训练归纳模型前从全文文章中选择一组句子[46,54]. 同样,MIRAGES也采取了一种提要式的提要式方法,从全文文章中选择显著的句子,并利用低等级的适应(LORA)对Llama-3-8B-指令进行微调[39]. 这些方法旨在减少汇总模型处理的输入文本的数量,同时保留整条中的相关信息。

blocks.en: Other systems have adopted alternative strategies to reduce the input length before summary generation. UIUC BioNLP extracted salient content from articles before fine-tuning GPT-3.5 [ 57 ] , whereas BDA-UC3M used extracted content in conjunction with compact models on the PLOS and eLife datasets [ 41 ] . In contrast, Aard divided full-text articles into smaller chunks before performing zero-shot generation [ 21 ] . Although these methods differ in their implementation, they share the objective of avoiding the processing of an entire article as a single input.
blocks.zh: 其他系统采用了替代策略,在摘要生成前缩短输入长度. UIUC BioNLP在微调GPT-3.5 [57] 之前从文章中提取出显著内容,而BDA-UC3M则在PLOS和电子生命数据集上结合紧凑模型使用提取内容[41]. 与此相对照,Aard在进行零镜头生成前将全文文章分成小块[21]. 虽然这些方法在实施上有所不同,但它们都有一个目标,即避免将整条作为单一输入处理。

blocks.en: More recent work has investigated content selection explicitly as a means of improving summarization efficiency. Savaşlı et al. proposed GraphXtract, a graph-based approach that represents biomedical articles as graphs and selects salient sentences before LLM-based summary generation [ 44 ] . Evaluated on the PLOS dataset, the method was designed to reduce the volume of source text processed during summarization. Collectively, these approaches offer an alternative to strategies that rely exclusively on abstracts or process entire articles, enabling summarization models to operate on selected portions of the source text that are considered most informative.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作明确调查了内容选择,以此作为提高汇总效率的手段。 Savaşlı等人提出了GraphXtract,一种以图表为基础的方法,将生物医学文章作为图表,并在基于LLM的汇总生成之前选择显著的句子[44]. 对PLOS数据集进行评估后,该方法旨在减少汇总期间处理的源文本量. 集体而言,这些办法为完全依靠摘要或处理整篇文章的战略提供了一种替代办法,使归纳模型能够对被认为信息最丰富的原始文本的某些部分运作。

blocks.en: Full-text-based strategies
blocks.zh: 基于全文的战略

blocks.en: Full-text input has also been explored in biomedical lay summarization. Early BioLaySumm systems investigated long-document models, including BART and LED, to process full-text articles [ 31 ] . Similarly, ISIKSumm employed text chunking to accommodate article length and generated separate summaries using abstract and full-text inputs [ 12 ] . These studies explored strategies for incorporating information from longer biomedical documents, although the extent to which input scope affects summarization performance was not the primary focus.
blocks.zh: 在生物医学概括中也探讨了全文投入。 早期BioLaySumm系统调查了包括BART和LED在内的长文件模型,以处理全文文章[31]. 同样,ISIKSumm使用文本块来适应文章长度,并利用抽象和全文输入生成单独的摘要[12]。 这些研究探讨了从较长的生物医学文件中收集信息的战略,尽管输入范围影响归纳性能的程度不是主要重点。

blocks.en: CTyun AI adopted a related approach, using truncation and chunking to prepare full-text articles for fine-tuning [ 3 ] . Rather than processing each article as a single sequence, the system shortened or divided the input to accommodate the constraints of long-document processing. Although these strategies offer practical solutions for handling lengthy biomedical texts, the study did not include a matched abstract-only condition to directly assess the effect of input scope.
blocks.zh: CTYun AI采取了一种相关的做法,使用截图和块块来编写全文文章进行微调[3]. 系统不是将每篇文章作为单一的顺序处理,而是缩短或分割输入,以适应长文件处理的限制. 虽然这些战略为处理冗长的生物医学文本提供了实际的解决办法,但研究没有包括一个匹配的仅抽象的条件来直接评估输入范围的效果.

blocks.en: More recent research has investigated the potential of smaller language models for biomedical lay summarization. Nursal and Mitchell evaluated models with fewer than 8 billion parameters in a zero-shot setting using full-text articles [ 37 ] . Their findings indicated that smaller models could generate informative lay summaries, with some outputs also receiving favorable human evaluations. However, their evaluation did not extend to abstract-only input, few-shot prompting, or fine-tuning. Consequently, the relative effectiveness of different input scopes and adaptation strategies remains insufficiently characterized across these approaches.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究已经调查了较小的语言模型对生物医学外延归纳的潜力。 Nursal和Mitchell利用全文文章[37],在零镜头设定中评价了不到80亿参数的模型. 调查结果表明,较小的模型可以产生内容翔实的总结,一些产出也得到有利的人类评价。 然而,他们的评价并没有扩展到抽象的输入,少镜头的提示,或者微调. 因此,不同投入范围和适应战略的相对有效性在这些方针中仍然不够突出。

blocks.en: Methods
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: The methods are organized into three parts: dataset, fine-tuning and inference, and evaluation. Fig 2 shows the overall workflow of the study.
blocks.zh: 这些方法分为三个部分:数据集、微调和推论以及评价。 图2显示了研究的总体工作流程。

blocks.en: Fig 2: Overall workflow of the study. Biomedical articles from the PLOS and eLife datasets were used in abstract-based and full-text settings. The study compared LoRA fine-tuning and zero-/few-shot prompting, followed by evaluation using relevance, readability, factuality, and computational efficiency metrics.
blocks.zh: 图2:研究报告的总体工作流程。 来自PLOS和eLife数据集的生物医学文章被用于抽象和全文设置. 该研究比较了LORA的微调和零/短镜头的提示,然后利用相关性、可读性、事实质量和计算效率衡量标准进行评价。

blocks.en: Dataset
blocks.zh: 数据集

blocks.en: The PLOS and eLife datasets consist of biomedical research articles paired with expert-written lay summaries [ 20 ] . During preprocessing, abstracts were extracted from the article text and used as input for the abstract-only condition. The datasets were obtained from BioLaySumm 2025 [ 56 ] . Since gold-standard lay summaries were unavailable for the original test sets, new test sets were sampled from the training data. Each new test set comprised approximately 5% of the corresponding original training set, yielding a split close to 90/5/5 for training, validation, and testing, respectively (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: PLOS和eLife数据集由生物医学研究文章组成,并配以专家撰写的编目摘要[20]. 在预处理期间,摘要是从文章案文中提取的,并用作仅限抽象条件的投入。 数据集来自BioLaySumm 2025 [56]. 由于最初的成套测试没有黄金标准基础摘要,因此从培训数据中取样了新的成套测试。 每套新的试验集大约占相应的原始训练集的5%,在训练、鉴定和试验方面分别产生接近90/5/5的分数(表1)。

blocks.en: Table 1: Dataset split sizes for eLife and PLOS.
blocks.zh: 表1:eLife和PLOS的数据集分割大小。

blocks.en: All sampling was performed before the experiments using a fixed random seed of 42, without stratification. The newly constructed test sets, the prompt-selection set, and the few-shot samples were held out from model training and fine-tuning to prevent data leakage. The prompt-selection set comprised 25 samples from each dataset, while three samples from each dataset were used for few-shot prompting. The number of few-shot samples was limited to three because some eLife articles exceed 35,000 tokens, potentially exceeding the model’s context-length limit.
blocks.zh: 所有取样都是在试验前使用42个固定随机种子进行的,没有分层。 新建的测试集,即时选集,以及少数镜头样本均从模型培训和微调中进行,以防止数据泄露. 即时选择集由每个数据集的25个样本组成,而每个数据集的3个样本用于几发即时提示。 由于一些eLife物品超过35,000个令牌,有可能超过模型的上下文长度限制,因此几发样本的数量仅限于3份。

blocks.en: Table 2: Token statistics for eLife and PLOS.
blocks.zh: 表2:eLife和PLOS的数据。

blocks.en: As reported in previous work [ 20 ] , PLOS articles are shorter on average than eLife articles, a difference also reflected in the token statistics reported in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 如前一份工作[20]所报告,PLOS文章平均比eLife文章短,表2所报告的象征性统计数据也反映了这一差异。

blocks.en: Fine-tuning and inference
blocks.zh: 微调和推论

blocks.en: The experiments were conducted using Qwen3.5-0.8B [ 40 ] and MobileLLM-Pro-1B [ 23 ] . These models were selected because their context lengths were sufficient for the articles in the datasets and their computational requirements were compatible with the available hardware. All experiments were conducted in the same Google Colab environment using an NVIDIA L4 GPU.
blocks.zh: 这些实验是使用Quen3.5-0.8B[40]和MobileLM-Pro-1B[23]进行的。 这些模型之所以被选中,是因为其上下文长度足以用于数据集中的文章,并且其计算要求与现有的硬件兼容. 所有实验都是在同一Google Colab环境中使用NVIDIA L4 GPU进行的.

blocks.en: Prompt selection Ten prompt formulations were evaluated on the prompt-selection set using both models with greedy decoding. The prompt with the highest mean score across the same 11 evaluation metrics used in the main experiments was selected for subsequent experiments. The selected prompt was “Summarize the following in layman’s terms:” and was used throughout the remaining experiments. The complete set of prompt formulations and the corresponding prompt-selection results are provided in the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 快速选择 在即时选集上,对10种即时配方进行了评价,同时使用两种模式进行贪婪的解码. 主要实验中使用的相同11个评价度量中平均得分最高的速报被选入以后的实验. 所选的提示是 " 用非专业语言概括以下内容: " ,并在整个剩余实验中使用。 补充材料中提供了一整套即时配方和相应的即时选取结果。

blocks.en: Fine-tuning configuration All fine-tuning experiments used identical Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) settings. LoRA was applied to the q_proj and v_proj layers, with a rank ((r)) of 4, an alpha value of 8, and a dropout rate of 0.05. The rank was set to 4 in accordance with the original LoRA study, which demonstrated competitive performance using low-rank adaptation of query and value projections [ 22 ] . Models were trained for two epochs using a learning rate of ( 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} ), a batch size of 2, and eight gradient accumulation steps. Weight decay was set to 0.01, with 50 warm-up steps. Training was performed using bfloat16 precision, gradient checkpointing, and scaled dot-product attention (SDPA).
blocks.zh: 微调配置 所有微调实验都使用了相同的低RANK适应(LORA)设置. LoRA被应用于 q_proj 和 v_proj 层,等级((r))为 4,α值为 8,辍学率为 0.05. 排名根据最初的LORA研究确定为4级,该研究通过低排名的查询和价值预测调整来证明竞争业绩[22]. 对两个时代的模型进行了培训,采用的学习率是(2×10−4 2\times 10×4}),批量大小为2,8梯度累积步骤。 重量衰减被设定为0.01,有50个热身步骤. 培训使用bfloat16精度、梯度检查和规模化的点产品注意(SDPA)。

blocks.en: Fine-tuning was conducted under two input conditions: full-article input and abstract-only input. As reported in Table 2 , abstracts contain approximately 25.5 times fewer tokens than full articles in PLOS and 64.6 times fewer in eLife. Each fine-tuning condition was trained once, starting from the same base model, without intermediate checkpoint selection.
blocks.zh: 微调在两个输入条件下进行:全条输入和抽象只输入. 如表2所报告,摘要中的代号大约是《海洋法》全文的25.5倍,而eLife则减少了64.6倍。 每个微调条件都经过过一次训练,从同一个基数模式开始,没有中间检查站的选择.

blocks.en: Inference configuration The maximum number of newly generated tokens was set to 800 for all summaries. This limit was chosen to exceed the average lay-summary lengths reported for both PLOS and eLife [ 20 ] . Sampling was disabled using do_sample=False , and generation employed greedy decoding.
blocks.zh: 推论配置 所有摘要中新生成的令牌的最大数量被设定为800枚. 选择这一限度是为了超过PLOS和eLife所报的平均内测长度[20]。 采样使用 do_sample=false 被禁用,一代雇用贪婪的解码.

blocks.en: Consequently, the temperature, top_k , and top_p parameters did not affect generation. The end-of-sequence token was also used as the padding token. Identical inference settings were applied to zero-shot, one-shot, three-shot, and fine-tuned generation.
blocks.zh: 因此,温度、顶_k和顶_p参数不影响生成。 末序符也被用作贴纸符. 同样的推论设置被应用于零射,一射,三射,以及微调的生成.

blocks.en: Evaluation
blocks.zh: 评价

blocks.en: The generated summaries were evaluated along three dimensions: relevance, readability, and factuality. Relevance was assessed using ROUGE [ 29 ] , BLEU [ 38 ] , METEOR [ 2 ] , and BERTScore [ 59 ] . ROUGE, BLEU, and METEOR quantify lexical similarity between generated summaries and their reference summaries, whereas BERTScore assesses semantic similarity using contextual embeddings. Readability was evaluated using the Flesch–Kincaid Grade Level (FKGL) [ 25 ] , the Dale–Chall Readability Score (DCRS) [ 8 ] , the SMOG index [ 34 ] , and the Coleman–Liau Index (CLI) [ 13 ] . Lower values indicate greater readability, or easier-to-read text, for all four metrics. Factual consistency was assessed using SummaC [ 27 ] , FENICE [ 60 ] , and LongDocFactScore [ 35 ] . These metrics assess the consistency of generated content with the source text, providing complementary signals of potential factual errors.
blocks.zh: 对产生的摘要按三个方面进行了评价:相关性、可读性和事实性。 对相关性的评估使用了ROUGE [29]、BLEU [38]、METEOR [2]和BERTScore [59]。 ROUGE、BLEU和METEOR将生成的摘要及其参考摘要之间的语法相似性量化,而BERTScore则利用上下文嵌入来评估语义相似性。 使用Flesch-Kincaid分级(FKGL)[25]、Dale-Chall分级(DCRS)[8]、SMOG指数[34]和Coleman-Liau指数(CLI)[13]来评价可读性。 较低的数值表明所有四个度量的可读性更高,或更容易读取。 事实一致性评估使用SummaC [27],FENICE [60],和LongDocFactScore [35]. 这些衡量标准评估生成的内容与源文本的一致性,提供了潜在事实错误的补充信号。

blocks.en:
For the normalization and aggregation of these three metrics, no explicit weighting was assigned to the three evaluation dimensions. Instead, all 11 metrics contributed equally to the overall score. Consequently, relevance and readability each accounted for (4/11) (36.36%) of the aggregate, while factuality accounted for (3/11) (27.27%).
Before aggregation, each metric was normalized using min–max scaling. For metrics in which higher values indicate better performance, normalization was performed as follows:
blocks.zh:
为了实现这三个衡量标准正常化和汇总,没有为这三个评价方面规定明确的权重。 相反,所有11个衡量标准对总分的贡献是平等的。 因此,相关性和可读性分别占总数(4.11)(36.36%),而实际性占总数(3.11)(27.27%)。
集合之前,每个度量衡都使用分钟-最大缩放法实现正常化 。 对于数值较高表明性能较好的衡量标准,实现正常化的情况如下:

blocks.en: x ′ = x − min ⁡ ( x ) max ⁡ ( x ) − min ⁡ ( x ) . x^{\prime}=\frac{x-\min(x)}{\max(x)-\min(x)}. (1) For metrics in which lower values indicate better performance, the normalized score was calculated as: x ′ = 1 − x − min ⁡ ( x ) max ⁡ ( x ) − min ⁡ ( x ) . x^{\prime}=1-\frac{x-\min(x)}{\max(x)-\min(x)}. (2)

These transformations map the metric values to a common scale on which higher normalized scores consistently indicate better performance. The overall score was calculated as the arithmetic mean of the 11 normalized metric scores.
blocks.zh: 这些转换将计量值映射到一个共同的尺度,高水平的分数一致表明业绩更好。 总体得分计算为11个正常的公分数的算术平均值.

blocks.en: A limited manual assessment was conducted to examine potential hallucinations in outputs with the lowest factuality scores. These outputs were inspected for unsupported or contradictory claims. The observations were consistent with the low factuality scores assigned to these outputs.
blocks.zh: 进行了有限的人工评估,以审查实际质量最低的产出中的潜在幻觉。 这些产出被检查为无根据或相互矛盾的索赔。 这些意见与分配给这些产出的低实际分数是一致的。

blocks.en: For statistical analysis, each evaluation metric was calculated for every prediction in the test set. Statistical significance between paired experimental conditions was assessed using a two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test [ 53 ] , with scores paired by the corresponding test articles. The significance threshold was set to ( α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 ). The rank-biserial correlation was reported as the effect size.
blocks.zh: 就统计分析而言,每套测试中的每一预测都计算出每个评价指标。 配对实验条件之间的统计意义是通过双侧的威尔科森签名排名测试[53]来评估的,分数由相应的测试文章配对. 意义阈值被设定为(α=0.05\α=0.05). 排名与二等关系被报告为效果大小。

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: The results are presented according to the run time and the three hypotheses.
blocks.zh: 结果根据运行时间和三个假设来表述.

blocks.en: Runtime
blocks.zh: 运行时间

blocks.en: Table 3 shows the total runtimes of each setting across the two models and two datasets. All experiments were run in the same Google Colab environment with an NVIDIA L4 GPU.
blocks.zh: 表3显示两个模型和两个数据集中每个设置的总运行时间。 所有实验都在同一Google Colab环境中运行,并配有NVIDIA L4 GPU.

blocks.en: Table 3: Total runtimes of each setting across two models and two datasets.
blocks.zh: 表3:两种模型和两种数据集的每次设置的总运行时间。

blocks.en: H1: Abstract-based vs. full-text LoRA fine-tuning
blocks.zh: H1: 以摘要为基础的对全文本 LORA 微调

blocks.en: H1 examines the effects of input scope on summary quality and fine-tuning runtime by comparing abstract-based and full-text LoRA fine-tuning. The comparison was conducted separately on the eLife and PLOS datasets using both models.
blocks.zh: H1通过比较抽象的和全文的LORA微调来审查输入范围对简要质量和微调运行时间的影响. 使用两种模型分别对eLife和PLOS数据集进行了比较。

blocks.en: H1: PLOS
blocks.zh: H1: 海洋法

blocks.en: Table 4 presents the results of abstract-based and full-text LoRA fine-tuning on PLOS. Both models achieved higher overall scores with abstract-based fine-tuning than with full-text fine-tuning (Qwen3.5-0.8B: Holm-adjusted p < .001 p<.001 , r r ​ b = .68 r_{rb}=.68 ; MobileLLM-Pro-1B: Holm-adjusted p < .001 p<.001 , r r ​ b = .76 r_{rb}=.76 ).
blocks.zh: 表4列出了对PLOS进行抽象和全文LORA微调的结果。 两种模型通过抽象的微调实现的总分高于全文的微调(Quen3.5-0.8B:霍尔姆调整p < 001 p < 001,r r b =.68 r_{rb}=.68;MobileLM-Pro-1B:霍尔姆调整p < 001 p < 001,r r r b = 76. (原始内容存档于2019-09-26). r_{rb}=76.

blocks.en: Table 4: PLOS fine-tuning results on the test set.
blocks.zh: 表4:PLOS在测试集上的微调结果.

blocks.en: Abstract-based fine-tuning also yielded lower scores on three of the four readability metrics for both models, indicating improvements in readability on those measures. As reported in Table 3 , abstract-based fine-tuning was 4.90 times faster for Qwen3.5-0.8B and 4.56 times faster for MobileLLM-Pro-1B than full-text fine-tuning. These findings support H1 on PLOS in terms of both overall summary quality and runtime.
blocks.zh: 基于摘要的微调还使两种模型四个可读度量中的三个的分数较低,表明这些措施的可读性有所提高。 如表3所示,Qune3.5-0.8B的抽象微调比全文本微调快4.90倍,MobileLM-Pro-1B的微调比全文本微调快4.56倍。 这些调查结果从总体摘要质量和运行时间两方面都支持PLOS上的H1。

blocks.en: H1: eLife
blocks.zh: H1: 电子生命

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: This study investigated the effects of input scope on biomedical lay summarization by comparing abstract-based and full-text-based approaches across two models and two datasets. The discussion is organized around the three hypotheses, focusing on the implications of the findings for summary quality and computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 这项研究通过比较两个模型和两个数据集的抽象和全文方法,调查了输入范围对生物医学的概括作用。 讨论围绕三个假设进行,重点是调查结果对简要质量和计算效率的影响。

blocks.en: H1: Abstract-based vs. full-text LoRA fine-tuning
blocks.zh: H1: 以摘要为基础的对全文本 LORA 微调

blocks.en: Abstract-based LoRA fine-tuning achieved higher overall summary quality scores than full-text fine-tuning across both datasets and models, while reducing fine-tuning runtime by an average factor of 4.7. These findings suggest that using abstracts as fine-tuning input can offer a favorable balance between summary quality and computational cost in the evaluated settings.
blocks.zh: 以摘要为基础的LORA微调实现了总体汇总质量分数高于整个数据集和模型的全文微调,同时将微调运行时间平均减少4.7倍. 这些调查结果表明,使用摘要作为微调投入可在评价环境中在摘要质量和计算成本之间取得有利的平衡。

blocks.en: This result differs from Basu et al. [ 4 ] , who reported better performance with full-text fine-tuning on several metrics using the eLife validation set. Their study also employed the larger Llama 3.1 Instruct 8B model. Differences in model architecture, model size, and experimental configuration may contribute to the contrasting findings, although the available evidence does not establish which factor accounts for the difference.
blocks.zh: 这一结果与Basu等人不同。 [4],他们报告使用eLife验证集对若干度量的全文本微调改进了性能. 他们的研究还采用了更大的Llama 3.1 指令 8B模型. 模型架构,模型大小和实验配置的差异可能有助于形成对比性的结论,尽管现有证据没有确定哪个因素能解释差异.

blocks.en: One possible explanation for the advantage of abstract-based fine-tuning is that abstracts provide a concise representation of the article’s principal findings and conclusions. Their shorter length also reduces the amount of input processed during training. Full-text articles may contain additional details that are useful for generating comprehensive summaries, but they also require substantially more computation. The present results indicate that, under the evaluated conditions, this additional input did not translate into higher overall scores. Thus, abstract-based fine-tuning represents a computationally efficient alternative to full-text fine-tuning without sacrificing overall performance in these experiments.
blocks.zh: 抽象微调的好处的一个可能解释是,摘要简要地说明了本条的主要调查结果和结论。 其较短的长度也减少了培训期间处理的投入量. 全文文章可能载有有助于编制综合摘要的其他细节,但还需要大量计算。 目前的结果表明,在评价条件下,这种额外投入并没有转化为较高的总分。 因此,抽象的微调代表了在计算上高效的替代全文本微调而不牺牲这些实验的整体性能.

blocks.en: H2: Three-shot abstract prompting vs. full-text LoRA fine-tuning
blocks.zh: H2:三发抽象提示对全文 LoRA 微调

blocks.en: Three-shot prompting with abstract–lay-summary examples achieved higher overall scores than full-text LoRA fine-tuning and was, on average, 8.58 times faster across the two datasets and models. This finding suggests that providing a small number of examples of the desired summarization style can be an effective alternative to fine-tuning on full-text articles.
blocks.zh: 以抽象的 -- -- 概括性实例激发的三弹一弹,总体得分高于全文LORA的微调,平均是两个数据集和模型的8.58倍。 这一调查结果表明,提供少数所期望的归纳风格的例子,可以有效地替代对全文文章的微调。

blocks.en: The results differ from those of DeakinNLP [ 50 ] , where fine-tuning outperformed few-shot prompting. However, the methods were evaluated using different model families for the two approaches, limiting direct comparability. In the present study, three-shot prompting and LoRA fine-tuning were evaluated using the same models within a consistent experimental setup, providing a more controlled comparison of these approaches under the selected conditions.
blocks.zh: 其结果与DeakinNLP[50]不同,其中微调表现优于数发的提示. 但是,对这两种方法采用了不同的模式体系,限制了直接可比性。 在本研究报告中,在一致的实验结构中,使用同样的模型对三发催化和LORA微调进行了评价,从而在选定条件下对这些方法进行了更有控制的比较。

blocks.en: A potential advantage of three-shot abstract prompting is that it demonstrates the desired lay-summary style through examples without requiring additional model training. Furthermore, using abstracts rather than full articles substantially reduces the amount of input processed during inference. Together, these characteristics may explain the observed computational advantage. The findings suggest that three-shot abstract prompting is a practical alternative to full-text LoRA fine-tuning when overall summary quality and runtime are considered jointly. However, the relative performance of prompting and fine-tuning may depend on the model, dataset, and evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh: 三发抽象提示的一个潜在好处是,它通过实例展现出所期望的平庸风格,而不需要额外的模式培训。 此外,使用摘要而非全文条款会大大减少在推论期间处理的投入量。 这些特征加在一起可以解释观察到的计算优势. 调查结果表明,在综合考虑总体摘要质量和运行时间时,三发抽象提示是完全LORA微调的实用替代办法。 然而,促进和微调的相对表现可能取决于模型、数据集和评价标准。

blocks.en: H3: Abstract vs. full-text few-shot prompting
blocks.zh: H3: 摘要与全文

blocks.en: Abstract-based prompting achieved higher overall scores than full-text prompting across the evaluated zero-shot, one-shot, and three-shot settings, while being, on average, 5.31 times faster across both datasets and models. These results suggest that restricting the input to abstracts can improve computational efficiency while maintaining or improving overall summary quality in the evaluated prompting configurations.
blocks.zh: 以摘要为基础的提示在总体得分上高于全文,在经过评价的零拍、一拍和三拍设置上都发出提示,同时,在数据集和模型上平均快5.31倍。 这些结果表明,限制对摘要的投入可以提高计算效率,同时保持或提高所评价的提示配置的总体摘要质量。

blocks.en: Previous work, including 5cNLP [ 32 ] , has investigated zero-shot and few-shot prompting with different demonstration settings. However, it did not examine the same matched comparison between abstract-based and full-text-based input. The present study therefore provides complementary evidence on how input scope affects prompting-based biomedical lay summarization.
blocks.zh: 过去的工作,包括5cNLP [32],调查了以不同演示环境激发的零射和少射. 但是,它没有审查抽象输入和全文输入之间的相同比较。 因此,本研究报告提供了补充证据,说明输入范围如何影响基于催化的生物医学概括。

blocks.en: The observed advantage of abstract-based prompting may be related to the concise nature of abstracts, which typically foreground the principal objectives, findings, and conclusions of a study. In contrast, full-text articles contain extensive methodological details and additional information that may not be necessary for producing a concise lay summary. Processing the full article also increases the input length and associated inference cost. Nevertheless, the current results do not establish whether the performance differences arise from reduced input length, differences in information content, or both. Further investigation would be needed to disentangle these factors.
blocks.zh: 所观察到的抽象提示的优点可能与摘要的简明性有关,摘要一般会预见某项研究的主要目标、结论和结论。 与此相反,全文文章载有广泛的方法细节和补充信息,而编写简明的简洁摘要可能没有必要。 处理整篇文章也增加了输入长度和相关推论成本. 然而,目前的结果并不能确定业绩差异是来自输入长度的缩短、信息内容的差异,还是两者兼而有之。 需要进行进一步调查,以排除这些因素。

blocks.en: Overall, the findings across H1–H3 indicate that abstract-based approaches achieved higher overall scores and lower computational costs than their full-text counterparts under the experimental conditions examined. This pattern was observed for both fine-tuning and prompting, suggesting that the advantages of abstract-based input are not limited to a single adaptation strategy. However, these conclusions should be interpreted within the scope of the two datasets and two models evaluated in this study.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,整个H1-H3的研究结果表明,抽象方法的总得分和计算成本比所审查的试验条件下的全文高。 这一模式既用于微调,也用于催化,这表明抽象投入的优点不仅限于单一的适应战略。 然而,这些结论应在本研究评估的两个数据集和两个模型的范围内加以解释。

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: This study aimed to address a research gap by systematically comparing abstract-based fine-tuning and few-shot prompting with their full-text-based counterparts under a consistent experimental setup. The primary contribution is the finding that abstract-based approaches can achieve better overall lay summarization performance while substantially reducing runtime.
blocks.zh: 这项研究旨在通过在一致的实验安排下,系统地将抽象的微调和少许镜头提示与其以全文为基础的对应方进行比较来解决研究差距。 主要的贡献是发现抽象方法可以实现更好的总体概括性业绩,同时大大减少运行时间。

blocks.en: All three hypotheses were supported across both datasets and models. Abstract-based LoRA fine-tuning achieved higher overall lay summarization scores and was, on average, 4.70 times faster than full-text-based LoRA fine-tuning. Similarly, three-shot prompting using abstracts outperformed full-text-based LoRA fine-tuning while providing an 8.58-fold speedup. Furthermore, abstract-based prompting consistently outperformed full-text-based prompting across zero-shot, one-shot, and three-shot settings, with an average speedup of 5.31-fold.
blocks.zh: 这三个假设都得到了数据集和模型的支持。 以摘要为基础的LORA微调,实现了较高的总体平面总和分数,平均比以全文为基础的LORA微调快4.70倍。 同样,使用摘要的三发提示在提供8.58倍速度的同时,超过了基于全文的LORA微调。 此外,以抽象为基础的提示一贯超过以全文为基础的提示,跨越零射、一射和三射设置,平均速度为5.31倍。

blocks.en: These findings suggest that abstract-based approaches can offer an effective and computationally efficient alternative to full-text-based summarization, particularly when abstracts adequately capture the key information presented in the corresponding articles. By reducing the amount of input text, these approaches can lower computational costs and accelerate summary generation without compromising overall lay summary quality under the experimental conditions examined in this study.
blocks.zh: 这些结论表明,抽象方法可以提供一种有效和具有计算效率的替代以全文为基础的归纳方法,特别是在摘要充分收录相应文章中提出的关键信息时。 通过减少输入文本的数量,这些方法可以降低计算成本,加快摘要生成速度,同时又不损害本研究所审查的实验条件下的总体编成摘要质量。

blocks.en: This study has several limitations. First, the experiments were restricted to relatively small language models because of the computational demands associated with evaluating numerous experimental configurations, limited GPU resources, and model context-length constraints. Consequently, the extent to which these findings generalize to larger language models remains to be investigated. Second, the evaluation relied primarily on automatic metrics, and no clinician-based assessment was conducted. Future work should therefore investigate larger models and incorporate expert evaluations to assess the factual accuracy, clinical relevance, completeness, and readability of the generated lay summaries. Such evaluations would help establish whether the observed efficiency and performance advantages of abstract-based approaches extend to broader model settings and practical biomedical communication scenarios.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有若干局限性。 首先,由于与评价众多实验配置相关的计算需求,有限的GPU资源,以及模型上下文长度的限制,实验被限制在相对较小的语言模型上. 因此,这些结论在多大程度上概括到更大的语言模式仍有待调查。 第二,评价主要依靠自动衡量标准,没有进行临床医生评估。 因此,今后的工作应调查较大的模型,并纳入专家评价,以评估所生成的概要的事实准确性、临床相关性、完整性和可读性。 这种评价将有助于确定所观察到的抽象方法的效率和性能优势是否扩大到更广泛的模型环境和实用的生物医学交流情景。

blocks.zh: 补充材料。 本条附有一份单独的补充文件。 它包含了完整的即时提法和即时选取结果. 3篇文章被随机选为eLife[33,10,49]的少拍例,3篇选自PLOS[7,28,47].
